articles.title: Quote-free and design-only portals use saved company branding and theme
articles.body: A portal does not need a quote to display saved company branding. Open the client link and enter the current portal PIN. After unlocking, empty portals and Copy client design link views load the company name, logo and account portal theme through the protected portal endpoint. A saved per-portal theme override still applies. Configure that override using Dashboard > Manage Portals > Theme; using the default keeps the account theme. Missing branding before unlocking does not mean your settings were erased. If Your Contractor, a missing logo or the default blue layout remains after unlocking, refresh and unlock again; confirm the company branding and portal theme were saved. The web app and portal-designs Edge Function must both contain this fix. Do not add a placeholder quote, delete the portal, re-upload models or reset saved themes to work around this issue. Viewing does not save or alter branding, designs or customer documents. An expired session or changed PIN requires unlocking again. Local regression checks are not confirmation of a live customer browser test.

articles.title: Choose an existing design room or create a new room
articles.body: In the admin portal choose Designs & Renderings > Add design or Replace / edit. Project / room is a dropdown of existing design groups in this portal, including withdrawn designs, plus Project designs. It does not import every room from quote documents. No quote is required. Choose an existing room, or Create new room… and enter New room name (up to 160 characters). Blank or whitespace-only names are not accepted; a name matching an existing room ignoring case reuses that group. Editing preserves the current group; new designs start with the current project filter when selected. Complete the other design fields and click Add to portal or Publish replacement, then wait for Design saved to the portal. A new group is saved with the design, not merely by typing its name. Closing without publishing creates no room. This groups designs only; it does not create or rename quote rooms. If publishing fails keep the original files and retry after resolving the displayed error; check Refresh before repeating an uncertain upload. Moving a design to a different group can change which project presentation it belongs to; review Presentation order afterwards.

articles.title: Large interactive model viewer window
articles.body: Choose Open design for an interactive model in Designs & Renderings. The viewer automatically uses almost the entire browser viewport, leaving a narrow rounded border and visible backdrop. Resize the browser and the model frame resizes with it. Close and presentation controls remain outside the model; on very short windows the dialog can scroll. Close does not confirm a presentation step or save model adjustments. QDR also permits the isolated model to request true fullscreen when its fullscreen button is clicked. The uploaded model must implement requestFullscreen with rejection handling; browser/device support and embedding policies still apply. Exit fullscreen with Escape on desktop or the browser/device exit control to return to QDR controls. This does not grant parent-page access, storage, native confirmation popups or network access. Reset All that uses window.confirm still needs an in-model confirmation dialog from the model author. If fullscreen is unavailable use the enlarged bordered viewer. If it still looks small, refresh the portal after the matching web release; empty space inside the model itself may be controlled by the uploaded viewer. Keep originals locally; do not delete a design just to resize the window. No uploaded files or model quality are changed.

articles.title: Design loading bar and slow model previews
articles.body: Open design in Designs & Renderings shows an animated loading bar while retrieving and opening the file. It is an activity indicator, not a download percentage or a guarantee that the connection is working. Keep the window open on slower devices. Interactive models may continue initialising after their embedded page appears; QDR cannot measure completion inside the isolated model. Images wait for decoding; PDFs wait for their first-page preview attempt. Normal presentation Continue appears after opening, not during download. I can’t view this — continue anyway remains available for viewing problems; using it while loading asks you to confirm skipping. Cancel that confirmation to keep waiting. A failed load displays its error and retains the explicit fallback; nothing automatically skips the presentation order. Closing stops viewing without confirming that step, so reopen it to retry. No quote acceptance or saved model edits result from loading. Reduced-motion settings show a steady indicator. Publishing uses animated Saving dots until success or error; wait for Design saved to the portal before assuming publication succeeded. Keep original files locally. These instructions describe the matching web release; local checks do not prove a customer device can render the model.

articles.title: Empty portal links before adding quotes or designs
articles.body: After creating a portal, open Dashboard > Manage Portals > PIN > Copy Link. A link is available even with zero documents and no designs. No placeholder quote or invoice is created. Share the link and the portal PIN, never the admin preview link. This full portal entry link stays usable when published documents are added later; recipients refresh and unlock with the current PIN. Existing secure short links still work. Copy client design link in Designs & Renderings remains a separate design-only link. Recipients need a current verified PIN session before the new entry route loads document access; expired sessions or a changed PIN require unlocking again. An empty portal shows no documents yet, not a requirement to create a quote. Copy Link does not send a message or publish documents. Clipboard blocked: select and copy the link field manually. If opening says the portal changed, refresh and enter the PIN again; if the document link needs repair, ask the contractor to refresh and prepare the document portal link. Do not delete or recreate the portal to recover a link. The web app and portal-designs Edge Function must be released together. Source and local regression verification is not proof of a live customer walkthrough.

articles.title: Standalone design presentation order: tutorial before model and progress after reloading
articles.body: Before a quote exists, open the admin portal > Designs & Renderings > Presentation order. Select Project / room, use Move up or Move down to place the tutorial video first and the interactive model second, optionally tick Require viewing in this order, then click Save presentation. Wait for confirmation. Reopen Presentation order and choose Preview saved presentation to test the client flow without recording client completion or quote approval. You need published designs in the same project and account permission to share quotes. Without the requirement, cards follow the saved order but clients may open any design. With the requirement, clicking a later design first opens its earliest unreviewed predecessor. Open external design launches the video/link in another tab; return to QDR and choose I’ve watched / reviewed this — continue. The next design opens automatically. QDR cannot prove external playback or completion. I can’t view this — continue anyway is an explicit viewing-problem fallback, including file-read failures. This is a guided presentation, not a security lock, signature or receipt. Progress lasts only this page visit; reloading restarts the sequence, and changed designs/order require review again. Withdrawn designs are skipped; new designs in a configured project appear last. Projects have independent sequences. Quote attachment order and design-before-pricing gates remain separate; standalone review does not satisfy quote approval. A conflict means refresh, reopen Presentation order and reapply changes, not overwrite newer edits. Closing or switching projects warns about unsaved changes. Saving the order does not alter uploaded files, prices or send client messages. Keep original models locally. The matching migration, portal-designs Edge Function and web release must be deployed together before using this feature.

articles.title: Portal theme: amount still owing or document total
articles.body: In Settings > Portal Theme or Theme Studio > Theme Details, choose Document amounts: Amount still owing or Document total. Amount still owing is the default when no choice was saved. In Theme Studio click Save Current as Default, or Save Custom Theme and select Set this custom theme as the default portal theme when saving if it should be your default. To override just one portal, open Dashboard > Manage Portals > Theme, enable Custom theme, choose Document amounts and save the theme. Portals using a custom theme keep their override until changed or returned to Use Default Theme. The live Theme Studio preview updates without changing real customer documents. Amount still owing deducts recorded payments on invoices and accepted quotes; an unaccepted quote remains labelled Quote total, not a payable bill. Document total shows the full document value. Balance Due in the summary always uses remaining balances regardless of the card display choice. The saved payments-received aggregate includes mirrored payment entries and is not added to them again; legacy entry-only records exclude explicitly pending/reported/failed payments. Paid documents show zero owing; overpayments do not display a negative balance. Invalid documents show a reference total and are excluded from Balance Due. This setting does not edit prices, mark payments received, issue an invoice or send messages. You need account access to save themes; wait for the saved confirmation before leaving. If a deposit is missing, inspect the invoice's recorded payments rather than re-entering a payment simply to change the portal display. Refresh after the matching web and client-document release. Unknown or design-locked pricing remains unavailable until access requirements are met. Keep normal document backups; theme settings are not a payment ledger or proof of payment.

articles.title: Recommended portals first when sharing a quote or invoice
articles.body: When the builder opens the portal-assignment chooser for a quote or invoice, existing matching portals appear at the top under Recommended portals. Remaining portals appear separately under Other portals. Each group is alphabetical by portal name; a portal is not repeated in both groups. With no recommendations, the normal alphabetical list remains. Recommendations use the existing client-matching rules and do not automatically select, merge or add anything. Review the client name, email and document count, then click Add here for the intended portal. Multiple distinct portals may have the same client name and can both be recommended; they are not automatically combined or deleted. If there are no portals, use the chooser's create-portal controls. You need an authenticated account and permission to share the document, and normal save/send checks still apply. Confirm the source quote is saved before sharing; if assignment fails, check its actual portal status before retrying. Do not delete a similar-looking portal as a display fix. If recommendations remain mixed into the alphabetical list after the matching release, refresh QDR.

articles.title: Preview Invoice without creating dashboard duplicates
articles.body: In the builder choose Invoice Actions > Preview Invoice or the file menu > Preview Invoice PDF. This opens a local browser snapshot labelled Preview — not issued. Repeated previews do not save an invoice to the cloud, reserve invoice numbers, change the source quote status or ask for a card-payment review. Preview does not replace a pending invoice-sharing session. Signing, payment reporting, Stripe checkout and QuickBooks sending are unavailable in this unissued preview. Print / Save as PDF is available, but a local preview URL is not a client-sharing link and its data exists only in this browser's local storage. Use Share Invoice in Client Portal when you actually intend to create/save and share an invoice; that separate workflow still performs its normal numbering and checks. Preview is not a backup: save the source quote normally and confirm Cloud saved before leaving. If preview cannot store its local snapshot, keep the builder open and report the error; do not repeatedly issue invoices as a workaround. Refresh after the matching release if previews still create duplicates. Existing duplicate invoices are not automatically removed, merged or renumbered because they may have payments or signatures; review those records separately before any cleanup.

articles.title: Accepted quotes do not expire: accepted and signed dates
articles.body: Open an already accepted quote in Client View or its existing portal link. The acceptance deadline banner is hidden after acceptance, even when its original date is now in the past. The header displays Accepted On using the recorded acceptance/signature date instead of today's Prepared On date. Older accepted records without a usable timestamp show Accepted without inventing a signing date. Signed invoice headers display Signed on with their recorded date, or Signed if it is unavailable. Invoice payment due dates, balances, overdue payments, invalidation and superseded-document notices are separate and unchanged; signing does not mean payment was received. Unsigned quotes still display their validity deadline and expiry warnings. No setting, renewal, resend or save is required for this display change. If an accepted quote still looks expired after release, refresh and report the document and view used; do not remove it from the portal, re-sign or edit the customer record to repair the display. Keep normal backups before making any actual document changes. Local regression tests are not authenticated production verification.

articles.title: Invoice viewer: wider screen layout and wrapping discounts
articles.body: Open the invoice viewer through your existing invoice link or preview. The invoice automatically uses nearly the full available screen width; no setting or save is required. Discount explanations wrap within the Total column instead of extending over the page edge. Show more and the description fade appear only when the rendered description exceeds three lines. Click Show more to expand it or Show less to collapse it. Descriptions that already fit remain fully visible without a button or blurred last line. Resizing the window or rotating a phone recalculates whether the text fits, preserving your explicit expanded choice. Pricing and discount calculations are unchanged. Print / Save as PDF shows full descriptions and uses the printable page width rather than the desktop screen width; review the browser print preview before saving. On a phone the available width is still limited, so long discount explanations can take several lines. If an unnecessary Show more button, fade or old narrow layout remains after release, refresh the viewer and check browser zoom. This display-only change does not edit, resend, accept or pay an invoice; retain normal invoice backups and do not modify customer records to test it.

articles.title: Warning-only storage accounts: thresholds without quota blocks
articles.body: A server-authorized warning-only storage account continues uploading beyond its shared retained-storage and monthly upload thresholds. Dashboard > Check storage labels this mode explicitly; normal thresholds remain visible and usage is still counted. Warnings continue at 80%, 95% and above the threshold. Render saves display usage beside their success message. Older saved-photo and portal-file account-cap checks also honour the verified exception. It is not a self-service toggle, cannot be enabled through an editable email or browser preference, and does not change other customers' limits. It does not disable file-size, file-count-per-item, file-format, security, voice retention, service-provider or unrelated AI/payment limits. The 30 MB render file cap remains until larger-transfer support is released. No automatic purchase or deletion happens. Keep originals and verify saved files after interrupted uploads. This option becomes available only with its matching storage release; a local change is not proof that a live account is exempt.

articles.title: Check storage: shared account space and monthly upload bytes
articles.body: After the coordinated storage-budget release, sign in to the appropriate account and click Dashboard > Check storage. The result shows retained storage and uploaded/reserved bytes this UTC calendar month. New owners receive 10 GB retained storage and 2 GB monthly uploaded bytes; existing accounts keep at least their previous combined allowances, so read your displayed limit. Photos, portal job files, designs, thumbnails, payment proof and voice evidence share the managed budget; their existing per-file restrictions still apply. Legacy signatures and embedded database images are not newly metered by this release. This is not a cap on downloads, bandwidth, database costs or total billing. Warnings appear at 80% and 95%; exceeding either allowance blocks new managed uploads but does not delete existing files or prevent reading them. No automatic storage purchase or charge occurs. Successful replacements and thumbnails count. Metadata edits, external links and local previews do not upload bytes. Failed or interrupted uploads may reserve capacity for three hours; a successful transfer still counts if a later save fails. Signed payment/voice uploads temporarily reserve their bucket maximum and are reconciled to actual bytes. Retries on the same immutable path do not charge twice. Monthly usage resets at the start of the next UTC calendar month; pending uploads still reserve capacity. Deleting an eligible file frees retained space but does not refund uploaded bytes; retained model versions still occupy storage. Do not delete customer files just to test quota. Keep originals and backups, refresh after a lost save response, and verify the saved attachment before retrying. If Check storage fails, refresh and retry; the migration, web app and all upload functions must be deployed together. No paid add-on or larger-file transfer capability is implied by the shared allowance.

articles.title: View an expired quote's existing portal and activity
articles.body: On the Dashboard, find the already-shared quote and click its green Client Portal button, then Activity in the portal window. An expired quote can still open its existing portal and recorded activity; viewing does not renew its expiry, republish the document, or require a deposit or zero-price review. Sign in with the appropriate account access; the document must still be assigned and visible in its portal. Opening the window can copy its existing link, but does not email the client. Publishing a document or Email Portal Follow-up still runs send-readiness checks and blocks expired or invalid quote dates. Do not renew, remove or resend a quote merely to inspect its history. If opening an existing portal shows Update Quote Expiry, refresh after the fix is deployed; if it persists, report the action and error instead of changing customer records. Activity requires a successful authenticated load; an error or empty history is not proof the client never viewed it. Keep normal save and backup precautions when making any actual quote edits.

articles.title: Designs and Renderings: 30 MB walkthroughs and monthly uploads
articles.body: After the matching web, Edge Functions and migration release, a contractor with quotes.send permission can open Designs & Renderings > Add design in the client portal. Choose Image rendering, PDF drawing or Interactive HTML (automatic preparation), enter a title and select a file up to 30 MB (30,000,000 bytes). Model geometry, textures and embedded still images are not downscaled; the optional card thumbnail is resized separately. Click Prepare & preview selected file for HTML, test controls, close preview and tick I previewed this interactive design and its controls work, then Add to portal. The shared storage-budget release replaces the old three-files-per-month rule with retained bytes and monthly upload bytes across managed files; use Dashboard > Check storage. Replacements and thumbnails count, including successful transfers whose later save fails. Previews, metadata edits and links do not upload bytes. Withdrawing does not delete retained versions or refund monthly bytes. Existing designs remain readable at the limit. Keep originals and a ZIP backup locally; ZIP is not a portal upload format. The final HTML, not the whole working folder, must fit the per-file limit. Self-contained HTML can use inline JavaScript and embedded blob modules; network requests, nested frames, workers, eval and parent access are blocked. Browser storage and fullscreen may be unavailable: catch failures, supply touch controls and a WebGL fallback. For larger files use an External design link with independently managed hosting/privacy, or wait for larger-file transfer support; do not degrade the model just to fit. After a failed or lost save response, refresh and check whether it saved before retrying. Withdraw cannot recall copies already opened. Live upload, mobile performance and authenticated chatbot checks require separate verification.

articles.title: Line Discount: dollars off each unit versus the whole line
articles.body: In Add Line Item or Edit Line Item, open Line Discount and choose $ off each unit. Enter a positive discount amount and an optional label such as Honour original pricing, then Add Line Item or Save Changes. For six doors at $650 with $50 off each unit, the discount is $300 and the line is $3,600 before any applicable markup and tax. Changing quantity automatically changes this discount; fractional quantities work too. $ off line total is the old fixed one-time dollar discount, and % off is unchanged. Per-unit means the line quantity, not one discount for each selected add-on. Leave Apply discount to selected upgrades/add-ons off to cap the discount at the base-item price and leave upgrades at full price; turn it on to allow it against the combined eligible price. Discounts are capped and cannot make an eligible line negative. Price TBD is not a priced discount calculation. Existing markup and tax rules still apply; review the final client preview and totals. Cancel discards editor changes; wait for Cloud saved before closing, refreshing or switching quotes. The quote edit does not itself change the reusable database price; do not choose Update Database unless you intend to change the saved item. Existing quotes with $ off line total retain their old behaviour. Web and dependent backend functions must be released together before using the new type in live client documents.

articles.title: Phone reminders for daily work logs without SMS
articles.body: Open Labour Tracker > Optional phone reminders. Deployment and server push configuration must be complete first; otherwise the panel says reminders are not configured. Choose Reminder time and optionally Include weekends, then Enable reminders on this device and allow browser notifications. Default is weekdays at 17:30; quiet hours are 20:00–08:00 in the displayed saved time zone. Re-enable to save schedule changes. One web browser/device per account is supported; enabling another replaces the previous device and disables the older native mobile morning/evening schedule. On iPhone, add QDR to the Home Screen and open it there. Send test notification sends immediately, at most one attempt per five-minute window. Accepted means the push service accepted the request, not confirmed phone delivery. Check permissions, connectivity and phone notification settings if it does not arrive. No SMS number is needed; it is a push notification, not a text-message conversation. Tap it to open Daily Work Check-in, sign in if needed, and manually record tasks and hours against quote items. The dashboard retains a Daily work check-in card and pending review count even without notifications. Any saved check-in for that date suppresses the web reminder; it does not assess whether every job is complete. Failed or uncertain daily sends are not retried that day to avoid duplicates. Turn off reminders disables web delivery but does not restore the old native schedule; an already in-flight notification may still arrive. Never assume a notification recorded hours: save the work log, confirm saving, and approve it separately. AI task matching is not part of this manual form. This release was reviewed against local source; real-device delivery, server setup and authenticated chatbot verification remain separate release checks.

articles.title: Daily Work Check-in: actual hours and suggested labour production rates
articles.body: Open Labour Tracker and scroll to Daily Work Check-in. Sign in with access to Labour Tracker; the existing daily-check-in database table must be available. Choose a saved Quote and Room / line item, date and optional worker name. Enter hours worked per person excluding unpaid breaks and the number of people working those hours; four hours with two people is eight labour-hours. For unequal worker hours, enter separate logs. Enter quantity completed today, not the whole quoted quantity. Choose Original scope / normal work, Extra scope, Rework or Waiting / delays and describe the work. Save draft work log does not change a quote estimate, saved item, GPS session or payment. Approve log or Reject log in the review list. Approved normal-work entries alone produce weighted units-per-labour-hour suggestions; rework, extra scope and waiting do not train the rate. The original item labour settings are saved as a snapshot for comparison. To adopt a suggestion manually, open Manage Line Items, find the same category/name/unit, set Labor Time to Units/hr, enter the reviewed suggestion and save the item explicitly. Existing quotes are not automatically rewritten. Future item use and the existing Timeline Report use the saved estimate; this is not a dependency-aware calendar schedule. Suggestions pool identical category/name/unit across the latest 500 check-ins: inspect scope and sample size. Tracker session comparisons use loaded approved sessions from the last 90 days and do not automatically reconcile crews, payroll or breaks. This form is manual: SMS reminders, AI task matching and one-click rate adoption are not available here yet. It does not use the legacy mobile endpoint's automatically learned rates. If saving is unconfirmed, keep the page open and use Retry same draft; it checks the same record ID instead of inserting another. Do not close the tab or enter the same log elsewhere until resolved; pending form recovery after closing is not supported yet. If a record changed during review, reload rather than overwrite it. Historical room/item snapshots are not automatically relinked after items are moved, split or deleted.

articles.title: Enter a negative rate or material reimbursement on a phone
articles.body: In Add Line Item or Edit Line Item, enter the amount in Rate ($), then tap the +/− button beside it to switch between a negative credit and a positive charge. This works without a minus key on the mobile keypad. Enter a nonzero amount first; blank or zero is unchanged. Turn off Price TBD to enable Rate and the sign button. Negative rates show a Credit hint; with a positive quantity they reduce the line total. For a single reimbursement enter quantity 1 and review the resulting total, including existing markup, discounts and tax settings. The button only changes the rate sign, not those settings or the quantity. Tap again to make the rate positive. Add Line Item or Save Changes applies the edit; Cancel discards it. Your saved item database is not changed unless you explicitly choose Save To Database. Wait for Cloud saved before leaving. A negative line is not a payment refund and does not send money. If the button is unavailable on an older page, save your work before refreshing; pasting a negative amount is a temporary workaround.

articles.title: Find in Quote: select and delete matching line items across rooms
articles.body: In the builder Tools menu open Find in Quote and search for the work, such as drywall, EPS panels or framing. Check individual results or Select all results. Inspect each room and item carefully: search also matches incidental words in descriptions and job notes. Show Values helps review quantities and prices. Clear selection deselects everything; changing the search also clears selection so hidden matches cannot be deleted. Delete selected shows a confirmation listing the rooms and items. Cancel leaves them unchanged. Confirm removes only those quote line items, keeps rooms and does not delete saved database items. Change-order original items follow the existing removed-item behaviour rather than being erased. Locked portal quotes and an active Split / Combine operation cannot be edited this way. Immediately use Ctrl+Z or a room Undo button to undo the batch before making further edits; undo history is page-session only and is not a backup after refresh. Normal quote saving applies: review totals and wait for Cloud saved before closing or switching quotes. This does not send client messages. Keep a backup before bulk cleanup; do not clear browser storage if saving is unconfirmed.

articles.title: Combine quotes: copy or move rooms into an existing dashboard draft
articles.body: Save the source quote and wait for Cloud saved. Quote Actions > Split / Combine Quotes offers New quote or an existing dashboard quote in Destination. Use Find an existing dashboard quote to filter by client, name or number, then choose the destination and rooms. Only a different unshared draft with no payment or acceptance history is eligible; invoices, change orders and deleted quotes are excluded. Choose Copy to leave the source intact, or Move for an eligible unshared source draft while leaving at least one source room. Review & Combine shows destination and source totals, then Combine Rooms confirms. Different clients require an extra confirmation. Incoming rooms are appended separately with new room IDs; their notes, photos, pricing and quote-only upgrade settings are retained. Destination client, currency, tax, terms, payment settings, expiry, category styling and quote-wide adjustment remain in effect. Source-wide adjustments and payments do not transfer. Currency mismatches and conflicting highlight meanings block combining; align meanings or change the source colour first. Existing destination content is retained. Already-transferred source rooms are blocked to avoid accidental duplicates. Both pre-operation snapshots are retained locally and available through Download pre-split recovery copy. Destination must save successfully and read back before Move removes source rooms. Close and reopen if either version changed. If a save is unconfirmed, do not repeat: inspect Sync and Recovery and both quotes, since queued changes can still sync. Download recovery copies before troubleshooting; do not clear browser storage or restore an old full quote over newer work. Combining does not send clients messages or combine balances owing. Related source/destination links appear in this dialog.

articles.title: Hide or enable an individual upgrade for this quote only
articles.body: In Add Line Item or Edit Line Item, expand Upgrades & Add-ons. Beside each upgrade option, uncheck Offer on this quote, then Add Line Item or Save Changes. The option is retained in the editor with Hidden; not charged, but removed from the offered client choices and pricing calculations. Disabling a selected upgrade restores the applicable base pricing; review the new total. Reopen the editor and check Offer on this quote to offer it again; re-enabling does not automatically select it or charge for it. Other quotes and the saved item database are unchanged. Cancel discards toggle edits. Save To Database or Update Database is a separate explicit action and retains the full reusable upgrade catalog, not this quote's hidden state. Quote-only upgrade definitions are retained instead of refreshed from the library. Wait for Cloud saved before closing or switching quotes and verify after reopening. Existing published copies require the normal quote update workflow; editing does not itself notify a client. Keep normal recovery backups and do not clear browser storage if cloud saving is unconfirmed.

articles.title: Find in Quote: Show Values for matching quantities and prices
articles.body: Open the builder Tools menu > Find in Quote. Search item names, categories, descriptions, job notes or rooms; all search words must match. Turn on Show Values to display each result's actual Quantity and unit, Rate (before discounts) and Line total (before tax). Rate includes applicable markup and the active rate; line totals use the builder's discount and change-order calculations. Price TBD is labelled instead of shown as a zero price. Items excluded from the quote total are labelled Not included in quote total. The toggle starts off and is remembered only within the current page session, including closing and reopening Find in Quote. It does not edit or save quote data or affect client views. Results show stored quantities, not measurements extracted from descriptions. Search can match incidental mentions of drywall or other work: inspect each match before adding quantities and keep square feet, linear feet and other units separate. There is no automatic aggregate total. Toggle off to hide values; the search text and scroll position remain. Click a result title to close search and jump to that item.

articles.title: PDF formatting: smaller text and fewer printed pages
articles.body: Use Download / Print PDF in an opened quote, or File > Export as PDF in the builder and complete the Client or My records choice. Clean PDF Settings appears before the browser print window. Choose PDF text and layout size: Large (100%) is the default, Standard (85%) is smaller, or Compact (75%) is most compact. Continue to Print applies the selection; Cancel or X does not print or apply a new selection. The choice stays in the open viewer only and resets to Large on a fresh page. Scaling affects print output including internal appendices, not the interactive quote, saved quote content, prices or text completeness. It does not add private reports to client PDFs. Leave browser Scale at 100% to avoid shrinking twice; turn off Headers and footers and enable Background graphics. Choose Save as PDF or your printer. Check readability, page breaks and final page count in browser preview; no specific reduction is guaranteed because paper size, margins and browser rendering differ. If too small, cancel the browser dialog and choose Large through Download / Print PDF again. Browser Ctrl+P bypasses QDR's formatting dialog. Live editor previews cannot print: open the quote preview first. Keep normal quote backups; PDFs do not replace editable recovery files.

articles.title: Split Quote: move or copy basement rooms into a separate phase quote
articles.body: Save the original and wait for Cloud saved, then open Quote Actions > Split / Combine Quotes. Enter New quote name, check rooms/phases and choose Copy or Move. Copy is the default and leaves the original unchanged. Move is restricted to unshared drafts without payment or acceptance history and must leave at least one room. Invoices and change orders cannot be split here. Review the displayed new draft and original totals, then Review & Create Draft > Create Draft. These are scope values, not amounts owing. Room notes, photos, highlights and line pricing are copied; quote-wide adjustments stay on the original and are not apportioned to the new draft. The new quote has its own number and is unsent. No payments, signatures, invoices or portal access are transferred, and no client message is sent. Review its payment settings and expiry before sharing: expiry starts afresh, and deposit review does not carry over. The new draft must be cloud-saved and its rooms read back before Move updates the original. A full pre-split local recovery copy is retained; Download pre-split recovery copy is available in this dialog. Storage failure blocks the operation before either write. Original and split drafts are linked under Split / Combine Quotes; links open separately. If saving is unconfirmed, check Sync and Recovery and the dashboard before retrying: a queued draft may still sync. If the draft exists but reducing the original fails, do not split again or share either document until resolving the pending save/conflict. Keep the recovery copy and never overwrite a newer quote wholesale to recover selected rooms. Local recovery is not a guaranteed off-device backup; preserve your normal backups.

articles.title: Attach up to three quote-only line item photos without saving to the database
articles.body: In Add Line Item or Edit Line Item, find Item photos below Reusable Item Description. Choose Add Photos and select one or several JPEG, PNG or WebP images, up to 10 MB each, with at most three photos per line item. Existing single photos are retained. Add Photos appends; Replace beneath a thumbnail changes only that picture, and Remove removes only that picture. At three photos Add Photos is disabled: remove or replace one first. Selecting too many files or an unsupported image changes nothing; choose fewer supported files and retry. Review the thumbnails, then Add Line Item or Save Changes. No database item is required. New photos are resized to at most 1200 pixels and stored as JPEG; keep originals separately. Cancel leaves the quote unchanged. Quote-only photo overrides, including removal, are preserved instead of refreshed from the library. Explicit Save To Database includes edited photos in the reusable item; otherwise the library is unchanged. Wait for photo preparation before saving. A failed upload leaves previous photos unchanged. Wait for Cloud saved and verify all photos after reopening; a thumbnail is not proof of cloud backup. Use Picture to browse the attached photos in the builder or client viewer. Keep versioned backups and do not clear browser storage to troubleshoot missing pictures.

articles.title: Highlight description display: colour defaults and Apply to all
articles.body: Open Highlight Item and select a colour. Choose Show description on each item or Only show description in legend. With Customize for this item / selection unchecked, Apply Highlight saves the colour's default for this quote and updates matching items without custom exceptions. New highlights inherit this default. Tick Customize for this item / selection to make an exception without changing the colour default. Tick Apply to all with this colour, click Apply Highlight, then confirm Apply to All to update EVERY existing matching item across all rooms, including older highlights and custom exceptions, as well as the selected items. Other colours and other quotes are unchanged. Apply to all takes priority over Customize and establishes the default for future highlights. Cancel confirmation keeps the editor open without applying. Colour choices and Clear remain drafts until Apply Highlight. Shared wording is preserved unless explicitly cleared. Legacy quotes without a saved default infer legend-only if all matching items are legend-only, otherwise inline; use Apply to all to reconcile mixed older items. Save and wait for cloud confirmation before switching quotes. Defaults are included in local and cloud quote data; retain recovery backups and do not clear browser storage to resolve save problems.

articles.title: Guided description: AI follow-up questions from rough task notes
articles.body: AI Refine > tick Guided mode — Ask follow-up questions, then choose Describe the task to create the description. Enter rough notes and choose Create Description. Guided mode is off by default and requires signed-in AI Refine access and an internet connection. It asks up to four relevant questions at a time, each with an answer box and Skip ×; Skipped — Undo restores a skipped question. Answer or skip the current questions, then choose Ask follow-up questions for another round. Generate with what I have is always available, including with unanswered questions. The AI stops offering questions when it finds no useful missing details; it must not repeat answered or skipped topics. Skipped or blank answers remain unspecified, not promised work or exclusions. Review Preview description, then Use Description or Keep Original. Cancel or Close leaves the original unchanged; interview answers are temporary and are not a saved quote backup. Each question round and final generation uses AI usage, with guided limits of 40 requests hourly and 200 daily and a bounded input size. For a long interview, generate with the details collected rather than starting unlimited rounds. If questions fail or time out, answers remain in the open dialog; retry or generate. Check all AI wording for invented scope before applying. If the editor changes or closes meanwhile, the result cannot overwrite it. Applying a description does not itself save the line item or confirm cloud saving: finish Add Line Item or Save Changes and verify the save status. Ordinary Refine what I've written and non-guided creation remain available. Source and local tests are not proof of live AI answer quality.

articles.title: Highlight descriptions missing after switching quotes
articles.body: Highlight explanations belong to each quote, not the account. An earlier cloud-save omission could retain line-item colours while losing yellow or orange descriptions after opening another quote and returning. Cloud saves now include highlightLegend and the legacy changeOrderHighlightLegend field. Apply Highlight, wait for Cloud saved, then reopen to verify. The fix does not recreate already missing text. Keep local JSON and versioned folder backups; compare the same quote's older backup for the wording. Do not overwrite a newer quote wholesale just to restore a legend, and do not clear browser storage. Re-enter recovered wording in Highlight Item and Apply Highlight, then verify cloud saving. Intentional clearing remains supported; another quote's descriptions are never used as fallback. If wording disappears again, retain backups and report the quote and save status.

articles.title: Keyboard shortcuts: autofocus and Enter in quote dialogs
articles.body: Dashboard > New Quote focuses Client Name after the modal opens. Type the client name, then press Enter from a single-line field to activate Create & Open Builder; required-field validation and normal cloud saving still apply. Tab moves between fields. When client suggestions are open, choose a suggestion with Tab then Enter, or Tab to another field before submitting your typed name. Enter does not create a quote while suggestions are open or the Create button is disabled. Builder Add Room focuses Room Name; Enter adds the room. Add/Edit Line Item focuses Quick Search; Enter from a single-line field activates the editor's primary action, but not while search suggestions are visible. Select a saved item or move to another field first. Manage Clients focuses its filter; Save Quote focuses File Name without automatically choosing a save destination. Shared text prompts focus their input after opening. Notes keep Enter as a newline; dropdowns, buttons, composing text and held-down keys retain their normal behavior. Payment, sending, deletion and multi-action dialogs have no new blanket Enter confirmation. Wait for the displayed cloud-save confirmation before leaving; a keyboard shortcut is not evidence of a successful save.

articles.title: Ask me for each quote: request a deposit or no deposit
articles.body: In Settings > Payments > Deposit & Invoice Requests, enable Ask me for each quote and save payment settings. This overrides the Request a deposit after a client accepts a quote switch. Default deposit type and amount are suggestions, not a completed choice. In Builder near View Profit Report, select Choose / review deposit for this quote. Choose Request a deposit and a positive percentage up to 100% or a positive fixed amount, or choose No deposit, then Use for this quote. The choice is saved with the quote through the normal save flow; wait for cloud-save confirmation. If an unanswered draft is shared from Builder or Dashboard, the deposit dialog appears before publication or email; Cancel or Escape stops that action without applying a choice. Existing shared quotes retain their terms. Reopening or resending the same reviewed quote does not ask again; a duplicated Dashboard revision requires a fresh review. Saved Send Quote Settings defaults do not count as a review for a new quote. The Send Quote Settings Deposit Requirement override can also explicitly choose show or hide for the current quote. Deposits are separate from card-payment rules, require no Stripe connection for manual payment methods, and choosing a deposit does not charge or message a client. Fixed deposits are capped at the quote total. Invoice and Change Order workflows are unchanged. If review cannot load, retry after refreshing and verifying payment settings; do not treat a dialog choice as proof that cloud saving succeeded.

articles.title: PDF export for clients or internal records and profit reports
articles.body: PDF export for either Client or My records (internal) does not open Card Payment Review and does not answer or change the quote's existing card-payment choice. The normal interactive sharing workflow still requires its configured payment review. File > Export as PDF asks who the PDF is for. Client is selected every time and never includes the private appendix. Choose My records (internal) to label the document INTERNAL — NOT FOR CLIENT and add export timestamp, quote number and status. Optionally tick Include profit report, which requires profit_tracking access. Continue to PDF opens the authenticated contractor preview and the browser print dialog; choose Save as PDF. Internal title suggests an INTERNAL filename, but the browser controls the final filename. The appendix starts on a new page and uses the existing private report calculations: revenue less estimated materials, before labour and overhead, not net profit. It includes per-line costs and warns about zero material estimates. Tax, payments and quote-wide adjustments are not allocated to individual lines; change-order profit is unsupported. Internal report data stays temporarily in this browser tab and is not added to client share data or sent to the client. The handoff expires after five minutes and is consumed once; if missing or expired, start export again from the builder. Normal cloud saving and authenticated preview access must succeed before export; this is not an offline PDF workflow. A PDF is a record, not an editable recovery backup: retain JSON or folder backups. Review every PDF before sharing, and never send a copy marked INTERNAL to a client. Browser print rendering and live authenticated chatbot answers still require release verification.

articles.title: Quote expiry and send-time validity
articles.body: In Send Quote Settings > Quote Expiry, choose Days from first client sharing, Fixed expiry date, or No expiry. New quotes without existing preferences default to 30 days; existing quote dates and saved preferences are preserved. Choose 30, 60 or 90 days, or enter 1–365 days. Preset buttons ask whether to Save as Default or use This Quote Only. Use these settings for future quotes also saves defaults. Automatic validity starts when first published to the client portal, not while drafting or previewing; publication itself makes the quote available, even before emailing. Editing or resending does not renew an already-started deadline. Renew Expiry explicitly resets the duration for the next sharing; portal-locked quotes must first follow the normal remove-from-portal editing workflow. Expired or invalid dates block quote sharing and quote email; open settings and update the date. Fewer than seven calendar days remaining, including today, warns with Send Anyway or Go Back & Review. Exactly seven days does not warn. No expiry is allowed. Invoice and Change Order expiry are not changed by this quote check. The date displays as the selected calendar day, without UTC shifting it to the previous day. Wait for cloud-save confirmation; opening settings or saving defaults is not confirmation that a client-facing change was saved. Previously distributed links cannot be recalled by a send blocker.

articles.title: Quote Builder basics
articles.body:
- Start or open a quote, fill client information, then build the quote by room or area.
- Add Room creates a room/area section. Add Item inside a room opens Add Line Item.
- Add Line Item can use Quick Search to find saved items. Users can also create a new unsaved line item, save it to the database, or add it only to the current quote.
- Line items include category, item/service name, description, quantity, unit type, rate, optional material cost, supplier URL, and optional upgrade information.
- Rooms support scope notes, photos, timeline estimate, markup, undo, room templates, saved groups, and grouping controls.

articles.title: Bulk editing and highlight colours
articles.body:
- To highlight several line items, tick their checkboxes within a room, then use that room's Edit > Highlight Selected... Choose a colour and Apply Highlight. Edit > Select All Items selects that room's items, not every room in the quote.
- The same Edit menu supports Move Selected to..., Copy Selected to..., Duplicate Selected Here, Markup Selected and Delete Selected. Do not confuse bulk selection with saved Choice Groups.
- A single row's highlighter opens Highlight Item. Clicking the selected colour again or Clear deselects the draft colour without closing the window. Apply Highlight commits changes; closing with unsaved changes prompts before discarding.
- Each colour may have an optional explanation and a choice to show it on each item or only in the legend. Enter an explanation for the legend; AI Refine can polish it. Highlight colour alone is not a description.
- Client quotes retain the on-page legend and can show a dismissible legend introduction. Contractor preview may suppress the introduction.
- Colour explanations are retained even when no items use the colour. Clearing a highlight does not delete its explanation. To remove shared wording, empty its explanation and Apply Highlight, then confirm Clear Explanation. Keep Explanation restores the wording and leaves the editor open. Unused colours are omitted from the client legend.

articles.title: Saving, backups and recovery: Export All Quotes, unsaved edits and photos
articles.body:
- Cloud saved and folder backup verified are separate statuses. Saved on this device or syncing is NOT confirmation of a cloud save. Do not promise a draft is in the dashboard until cloud saving succeeds.
- Connect Backup Folder lets a supported browser save versioned quote files into a user-chosen folder while QuoteDr is open. Back Up Now requests a backup. The browser must grant folder access; this is not an always-running desktop backup service.
- Folder backups are organized beneath QuoteDr Backups by account, client and quote. Unchanged snapshots are deduplicated, earlier changed versions are retained. Files are not encrypted and do not include all uploaded media.
- Changing folders replaces the connection after confirmation; Disconnect forgets the connection without deleting existing files. A remembered connection is not a verified write. If an error occurs, retain existing files and report the exact error; do not assume Google Drive is the cause or that a file's existence proves verification.
- Dashboard Export All Quotes creates a portable backup of cloud quote records. It is not a backup of unsynced browser edits, every invoice or all media. Save a local copy of unsynced work separately.
- Open a local recovery file with File > Open > Open Local File, review the recovered content, then explicitly Save to the intended cloud destination. Opening a recovery is not itself a cloud save.
- If cloud saving fails or conflicts, keep the local recovery copy, check the displayed error and contact support if needed. Do not instruct users to repeatedly overwrite or clear storage.

articles.title: Old quote import and AI Refine writing assistance for notes
articles.body:
- Tools > Import Old Quote accepts supported PDF, image, spreadsheet and text sources. Parse Quote, review rooms, descriptions, quantities, rates and totals, then Apply to Quote. It can replace the quote or append rooms.
- Missing-unit labels can be chosen in the importer. Review warnings and the review acknowledgement can block Apply until checked. Save Selected Items saves selected reusable items to the library; Apply to Quote is a separate action.
- Undo Import requests confirmation before restoring the pre-import quote. Do not promise it remains available after refresh or that later edits will be preserved.
- AI Refine is available for reusable descriptions, job-specific notes and highlight explanations. It improves wording; the user should verify scope and facts before applying.
- Job-specific notes belong to the current job; reusable descriptions belong to the item template. Do not advise saving job-specific details into the reusable database.

articles.title: Manage Items and saved pricing
articles.body:
- Manage Items is the saved pricing database. It stores categories, item names, unit types, rates, material costs, supplier URLs, descriptions, photos, and upgrade options.
- Users can add a new category from the category picker, add new items, edit rows, filter/search, expand details, and Save Changed or Save All.
- Manage Items > Add Category saves a named empty category without creating a dummy line item. It becomes available in the category picker. Add Item still requires an actual item name and unit.
- Material Cost is the user's cost for margin tracking. Rate is what the client is charged.
- Upgrade options can have their own unit, rate, material cost, supplier URL, description, and photo.

articles.title: Saved Choice Groups
articles.body:
- Manage Items > Choice Group is where users view, create, edit, rename, and delete reusable saved choice groups.
- To create a saved group, open Manage Items, click Choice Group, click New, search/select saved items from the user's item database, choose Pick One or Pick Multiple, choose the default/base option for Pick One, keep "Always use grouping when any of these items are added to a quote" on if desired, then save.
- Pick One means the client chooses one option from several choices, such as vinyl flooring, laminate flooring, or hardwood flooring.
- Pick Multiple means the client can choose more than one option, such as baseboards, shoe moulding, and crown moulding.
- Saved Choice Groups can be manually added to a room with Saved Group.
- When auto-grouping is enabled, adding a saved item that belongs to a saved Choice Group can automatically place the whole group on the quote instead of a single normal line item.
- Auto-grouping applies to manual Add Line Item and AI Voice To Quote when saved groups are found.
- The quote may ask "Grouped items found. Use saved groups?" with Yes, No, and Review for AI Voice results.
- In Review, users can uncheck grouped suggestions before they hit the quote.
- Turn Off Grouping affects only that quote row. It asks which grouped option should remain and converts that row back into a normal line item.
- Disable Grouping on a room turns off automatic saved grouping for that room and makes grouping disabled by default for future new rooms until re-enabled.
- For Pick One rows, the Pick One badge in the quote builder opens a picker so the user can choose which option is the selected/base visible item. That selected option moves to the top for the client view but does not change the saved group template.

articles.title: AI Voice To Quote
articles.body:
- AI Voice To Quote lets the user record a spoken scope, pause/resume recording, generate parsed items, and review before adding to the quote.
- AI Voice Review lists parsed items, puts uncertain or duplicate items at the top, lets users include/exclude rows, match typed phrases to saved items, add notes, save learned mappings, and keep or hide AI-generated room scope notes.
- For paint walls, QuoteDr should use perimeter times wall height when room dimensions and ceiling height are known.
- If ceiling height or another required measurement is missing for a relevant calculation, the review step should ask for it before finalizing.
- AI Memory stores user-specific phrase-to-item mappings learned from voice corrections.
- AI Trade Rules let users teach rules like "when I say case a door, apply 35 linear feet of 2-3/4 MDF trim per door."
- Voice Templates let users save reusable packages such as "standard bedroom package" and apply quantities from room dimensions.
- AI Voice can use saved Choice Groups through the same grouping helper as normal quote additions.

articles.title: Sending quotes, client choices, and approvals
articles.body:
- Send Quote Settings controls quote style, pricing detail, deposit display, approval type, expiry, and client message.
- Client views can show itemized pricing, category subtotals, or total-only depending on pricing detail.
- Approval Type can allow accept quote, accept/request changes, or review-only.
- Client-facing choice groups show Pick One or Pick Multiple options. The client can select options in the interactive quote view.
- Client notes/requested changes should be reviewed before updating a quote.

articles.title: Invoices and payments
articles.body:
- Quotes can be converted or sent as invoices from the invoice tools.
- Stripe Payments are configured in Settings > Payments.
- Settings > Payments can enable Stripe, set the default deposit percent, show a deposit payment button on quote links, and show a pay-in-full button on invoice links.
- Deposit payment button on quote links is for collecting deposits from accepted or shared quote links when enabled.
- Pay-in-full button on invoice links is for collecting full invoice balances when enabled.
- Manual payment instructions can also be shown for e-transfer, cash, cheque, or other offline payment methods.

articles.title: Dashboard, settings, and feedback
articles.body:
- Dashboard is where users create, open, manage, and track saved quotes.
- Settings includes Business Profile, Quote Preferences, Manage Items entry point, AI Voice Learning, email/reminder settings, Feedback, Payments, QuickBooks, and Account/Plan controls.
- Feedback is the correct place for bugs and feature ideas. Direct users to Settings > Feedback when QuoteDr does not have a requested feature yet.
- Basic includes core quoting, invoicing, clients, branding, sync, templates, and Stripe payments. Pro unlocks AI voice quote tools, AI assistant, smart import, floor plan scanner, QuickBooks, upsells, profit tracking, and reminders where available.

articles.title: Job note preview length
articles.body: In Send Quote Settings, use Job note preview length to choose how much of each job-specific note is initially visible in the client quote. Set the slider to 0 for full text, or choose 20–1200 characters before Show more. The client can expand the full note; this does not hide confidential content or delete any text. The setting is independent of description and scope preview lengths. The live preview updates and Save Defaults can retain the preference. Existing quotes without this setting keep full notes.
